Container.Name: filearr-worker
Container.Overview: Background worker for filearr: library scans, metadata extraction, hashing, search-index sync, recycle-bin purge. Same image as the main app, different command (set via Post Arguments). Requires the same 'filearr' Docker network and identical DB/Meilisearch settings as the filearr container. Scale concurrency with --concurrency N in Post Arguments.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: MUST be the same path as the filearr container (shared thumbnails/caches)

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media library root — must match the filearr container mapping exactly

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Same value as the filearr container

Config.Name: Procrastinate DSN
Config.Description: Same value as the filearr container

Config.Name: Meilisearch URL
Config.Description: Same value as the filearr container

Config.Name: Meilisearch Master Key
Config.Description: Same value as the filearr container

Config.Name: Postgres Data (disk monitor)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL read-only view of the filearr-postgres Data path — lets extraction pause before the database disk fills. Match the filearr container's setting; remove with the variable below to disable.

Config.Name: Postgres Disk Watch
Config.Description: In-container path of the Postgres data mount above (leave as /pgdata; clear to disable).

Config.Name: Semantic Search
Config.Description: Enables semantic/hybrid search; this worker downloads and loads a local ONNX embedding model and embeds items in the background. Safe default false (zero cost when off) — must match the filearr container.

Config.Name: Content Sniffing
Config.Description: Enables the on-demand maintenance action that reclassifies extensionless files by libmagic MIME sniffing (bounded prefix read per file). Safe default false — must match the filearr container.

Config.Name: Auto Update Check
Config.Description: Lets the Updates card refresh its stale GitHub release cache automatically; the only automatic outbound call the product makes. Safe default false — must match the filearr container.

Config.Name: Thumbnail Budget (GiB)
Config.Description: Advisory size budget for the thumbnail cache in GiB; over it you get a log reminder and an amber note on the Jobs thumbs card — nothing is deleted. 0 disables the advisory. Safe default 5.

Config.Name: Log Recorder
Config.Description: Records this worker's log stream into the database so the console Logs panel has content. Safe default true; set false to keep logs in the container output only.

Config.Name: Distributed Agents
Config.Description: Master switch for the distributed agent fleet surface (agent monitor tick and fleet jobs). Needs a CA and extra setup — safe default false; must match the filearr container.
